name: Sticky-rice wine
summary: Sticky-rice wine drunk with hearth buffalo, torn by hand, on the stilt-house floor.
howToEat: With the dried buffalo, on that account.
where: The stilt-house meal. A street was not named.
seoTitle: Ruou nep in Son La — sticky-rice wine with buffalo
seoDescription: Rượu nếp in Sơn La, the cup Báo Sơn La drinks with hearth buffalo.
